topic: Losing frozen account funds vs claiming exemptions on protected benefits (Miles vs Cleo)

scenes.narration: A creditor froze her account, but her Social Security stayed untouchable. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera in a courtroom beside a frozen bank account in ice with a glowing shield labeled SOCIAL SECURITY, comic burst banner reads UNTOUCHABLE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Miles and Cleo both have their bank accounts frozen by creditors.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man miles and woman cleo in the courtroom, each staring at bank accounts frozen in blocks of ice, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Social Security and disability funds are legally exempt from levies.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a glowing law book on the courtroom bench labeled EXEMPT FUNDS, shields marked SOCIAL SECURITY and DISABILITY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Miles panics and assumes every dollar is gone for good.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man miles panicking with hands on his head, a frozen account behind him labeled ALL GONE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He never files the paperwork to claim his exempt benefits.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man miles turning away from an unfilled form stamped EXEMPTION CLAIM, benefits slipping away, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Cleo learns her deposited Social Security is federally protected money.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman cleo reading a document with a glowing shield labeled PROTECTED SOCIAL SECURITY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She files an exemption claim with the court right away.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman cleo handing an exemption claim form to a court clerk, stamped FILED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Cleo also moves her benefits into a separate protected account.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman cleo moving money into a separate safe labeled PROTECTED BENEFITS ACCOUNT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Weeks later, Miles loses exempt money he could have saved.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man miles looking sadly at an empty account, a note reads EXEMPT MONEY LOST, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Recovering wrongly seized benefits now costs him time and lawyers.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man miles hiring a lawyer, a bill labeled COST TO RECOVER piling up, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Cleo's exempt funds are released and returned to her fully.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman cleo smiling as frozen funds thaw and return, a stamp reads FUNDS RELEASED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Claim your exemptions fast; benefits like Social Security cannot be seized. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel in the courtroom, a clipboard reads CLAIM EXEMPTIONS FAST, comic burst banner reads DISMISSED, kids comic book illustration
